artworks.title: Street Corner in Dresden (Strassenecke Dresden)
artworks.medium: drypoint on blotting paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban environment in a minimalist style with thin lines. The viewpoint is from street level, showing a path curving towards a cluster of buildings. A tall, leafless tree is on the left, and a building is on the right. In the middle are buildings with geometric rooftops. The scene lacks a visible horizon, focusing solely on urban structures. The bold, hurried sketches give an impressionistic feel. The monochromatic color palette of grays and black creates a stark effect. The composition is balanced by the placement of architectural elements and the path that leads the viewer's gaze into the scene.

artworks.title: Bridge on Crown Prince Embankment (Brucke am Kronprinzenufer)
artworks.medium: drypoint with tonal etching on blotting paper
artworks.description: The image features bold, sweeping lines and shapes on a textured surface, creating an abstract composition. Linear forms suggest arches resembling a bridge over a rectangular shape. Below this, two upright figures are seen. Irregular lines converge and stretch across the top, resembling stylized symbols or structural forms. The arrangement of lines and shapes constructs an abstract scene with a bridge and vessels.

artworks.title: The Shipwreck (Le naufrage)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts a seascape with two figures working with ropes on a rocky shoreline. In the background, a large sailing ship is caught in tumultuous waves with torn sails, approaching a rocky shore. On the left side, more ships are seen battling rough seas. The horizon is obscured by waves, and the sky is filled with crosshatched lines. A stone tower stands prominently on the right against the sky. The artwork is rendered in shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Pierre-Jean Mariette
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a half-length profile portrait of a man facing to the right within an oval frame. The man has detailed facial features, including an aquiline nose and slightly curved lips. His hair is styled in a classic 18th-century fashion, possibly a powdered wig. He wears an elegant suit with a buttoned coat and a high-collared shirt. A decorative fabric bow adorns the top of the oval frame. The background is crosshatched, and beneath the frame, there is elegant script stating the individual's name and title as P. J. Mariette.

artworks.title: Winter: Cat on a Cushion (L'hiver: Chat sur un coussin)
artworks.medium: color lithograph
artworks.description: This print shows a brown tabby cat lounging on a reddish-pink surface. The cat appears relaxed, stretched out with its head near the upper right corner and its feet and tail near the bottom left corner. It is on its side, with its stomach exposed. Its head is turned towards us, and it looks out at us with striking yellow eyes. The cat's fur is in shades of brown ranging from dark brown to tan, its nose is pink, and it has small tufts of tan fur coming from inside its ears. The background above the red surface is brown.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Marriage
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a chariot being pulled by lions. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shading. In the center, a chariot with decorated wheels is being drawn by lions. Two figures are in the chariot. Surrounding the scene are trees with foliage and small winged figures posed dynamically on the trees. The overall style is classical or mythological, with detailed mythical creatures and sophisticated line work reminiscent of baroque or renaissance influences.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with a Pyramidal Mausoleum
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pyramid-shaped structure with an ornate facade and sculptures on different levels. Steps lead up to a classical entrance with columns. Small figures are visible on the pyramid, suggesting scale. In the distance, tall structures can be seen with softened outlines. The horizon line is obscured by these distant shapes, creating depth. The style features loose brushstrokes emphasizing line and form. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia and brown. Various elements balance the composition, including a column with a figure on top and a carved pedestal.

artworks.title: Fantasy on an Ancient Campidoglio
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an architectural scene. It shows stone blocks, figures, a classical building with columns, a detailed figure on the roof, a tall obelisk, another classical structure in the distance, steps, swirling clouds in the sky, and a limited gray color palette with black outlines and wash.

artworks.title: The Holy Family under a Tree
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Sharon Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures beneath a large tree. The drawing captures a group of figures gathered under a tree, depicted in fine pen lines. The tree features prominently, extending from the foreground up to the top of the composition, with branches and leaves delicately sketched. The figures below are outlined with fluid and swift strokes. The use of line is expressive, with varying densities conveying texture and form. The scene has a natural setting due to the presence of the tree and the informal arrangement of the figures.

artworks.title: An Elegant Couple, a Gooseboy, and a Gentleman [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures and ducks. The drawing depicts a collection of loosely sketched figures across a simple and almost blank background. On the left, a figure stands adorned with clothing, drawn in an expressive manner with undefined features. In the center, another figure leans forward, appearing to engage with three duck-like creatures on the ground, drawn with quick lines and minimal detail. To the far right, a figure stands with a staff or walking stick, dressed in similarly unrefined attire. The entire scene is sketched in brown ink, showcasing quick, animated line work.

artworks.title: Two Elegant Couples [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures standing together. They wear elaborate headdresses with feathers or decorations and voluminous clothing. The figures appear to be in a loosely gathered group, with two closer together on the right side and one standing slightly apart on the left. The figures have indistinct facial features and the background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: The Little Girls' Tavern
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.6 x 9.4 cm (3 3/8 x 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two children in a bust view. One child is on the left, leaning forward with elbows on a table, wearing a loose shirt and a large hat. The other child on the right is holding toy scissors and tongs, with neatly brushed hair. A candle on a candlestick is on the table beside them.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Wearing a Turban
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person facing slightly to the side, looking directly at the viewer. The individual's head and partial shoulders are depicted with detailed lines, portraying a mature facial expression with deep-set eyes, a long nose, and a slightly downturned mouth. The person wears a soft, rounded hat covering most of their hair, and their clothing is suggested by minimal lines hinting at draped fabric. The background is a plain blue-grey color, enhancing the focus on the figure's facial features. No accessories or objects are shown in the drawing.

artworks.title: Studies of Women's Heads
artworks.medium: black and red chalk heightened with white chalk on light brown laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: This image shows detailed drawings of multiple young women's faces with partial necks visible. The women face various directions with delicate facial features, soft expressions, and gentle smiles. They have large, expressive eyes and varying hairstyles, some with headbands or ornaments. One woman wears an earring. The artwork is on a textured background, likely paper.

artworks.title: Delilah Cutting Samson's Hair
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Joos van Winghe
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene of combat in an architectural setting. The image shows a group of armored warriors engaged in a skirmish within a building with classical columns and arches. In the center, several figures are entangled in a struggle, with some bare-chested and holding weapons. One figure appears seated with a raised hand, surrounded by others in dynamic poses. The use of hatching and shading intensifies the scene, capturing action and interactions. The architectural backdrop adds grandeur and context to the moment depicted.

artworks.title: Solomon Led to Idolatry by His Wives
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Joos van Winghe
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 22.6 x 28.9 cm (8 7/8 x 11 3/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in a classical setting. At the center, a bearded man wearing a crown is seated on a throne, surrounded by richly dressed women. Some women are gesturing, with one holding a child. The background features columns, arches, and a tapestry. Through an archway on the left, there is a glimpse of an outdoor scene with trees and buildings.

artworks.title: Sardanapalus among the Concubines
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Joos van Winghe
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient interior scene with classical figures and ornate decoration. The artwork shows a detailed historical scene set in an opulent interior with several figures seated on a raised platform. Draped fabric and an archway frame the background. The figures appear to be in motion or engaged in an expressive interaction, indicating a narrative or mythological moment. The clothing, furniture, and architectural elements are intricately detailed with elaborate linework.

artworks.title: Heliogabalus and the Wise Women
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Joos van Winghe
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an opulent interior scene featuring multiple figures and a monkey. The figures are portrayed in an elaborate, classical setting, engaged in conversation or other activities, with some seated on thrones or steps and others standing or gesturing. The scene includes sumptuous drapery, with an intricately set table in the middle and ornate architectural details in the background.

artworks.title: Gothischer Kreuzgang (Gothic Cloister)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a Gothic cloister. It depicts a covered walkway with columns and arches, leading towards an open courtyard. The scene portrays a courtyard with architectural details, including a well or fountain, trees, and distant structures. The artwork uses fine lines to show the stone textures and medieval design. The color scheme is monochromatic, focusing on light and shadow for depth.

artworks.title: The Thames at Battersea
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a calm scene at water level, slightly to the side of a body of water. The horizon is at the midpoint, where land and sky meet. Structures like a windmill and red brick buildings are visible on the horizon. The painting has soft brushstrokes, giving the water a reflective quality. The color palette includes hues of pale blue, soft whites, and earthy browns. In the foreground, two figures in a boat are handling a net, with reeds nearby. In the background, there are trees against a cloud-filled sky.

artworks.title: The Card Game (Der kleine l'Hombre Tisch)
artworks.medium: etching and sulfur tint with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals sitting at a table. Two individuals are seen from behind, displaying elaborate head coverings and attire. The third person faces forward, visible from the waist up. This person has delicate facial features and wears a head covering with lace or ornately woven material. They are all dressed in garments from an earlier time period, with long sleeves and layers of fabric. They sit around a small table with a lit candle in an ornate candlestick. One individual appears to be holding cards. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the people and their clothing.

artworks.title: The Four Elements
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts mythological figures in a nature setting. The figures are interacting with each other amidst swirling clouds and a detailed landscape with plant life and a rocky structure. One figure in the upper left holds a bird, while another on the right holds a dagger above a creature. The central figure at the bottom wears a foliage wreath and holds stalks of grain. The illustration features intricate linework and shading, creating a textured and dynamic appearance.

artworks.title: Eros and Anteros
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a seated position, both bodies are fully visible. The figure on the left leans backwards while the figure on the right leans in closely towards them, their lips meeting. The male figure has curly hair, and the female figure has hair styled in a loose updo. Both figures are mostly nude, with some drapery covering parts of their lower bodies and wrapped around the male figure's shoulder. They are each holding a torch that emits thick, swirling smoke. The background features a rocky landscape with a sparse tree on the left side and rolling hills extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Without Ceres and Bacchus, Venus Would Freeze
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical mythological scene. The artwork depicts three nude figures engaged in an earthy, revelrous setting. One figure, on the left, is crowned with grapevines and holding a goblet aloft. The central female figure is adorned with jewelry and gazes away, her arm forming an arch over a cask, while the figure on the right, with wings, holds clusters of grapes and other foliage. They appear surrounded by lush fruit and a rich landscape, including a detailed tree in the background. The scene is highly detailed, with an emphasis on musculature and classical drapery.
